page_title: TOT 4-0 EVE | Tottenham Hotspur v Everton 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Anthony Taylor has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
90+2' The ball is out of play. Everton win a corner kick.
90+2' Harrison Armstrong (Everton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Everton have a corner.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Harrison Armstrong (Everton) is on for Idrissa Gueye.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
88' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
87' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) tries to find Jesper Lindstrom, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
86' The attendance is 61357.
80' Michael Keane (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch so that James Maddison can be given a rest.
77' 4 - 0 GOAL! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) runs onto a pass from Micky van de Ven after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 4:0.
75' Beto (Everton) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
73' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Djed Spence.
73' The substitution has been made. Archie Gray (Tottenham) has replaced Yves Bissouma.
72' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Dominic Calvert-Lewin and he is replaced by Beto (Everton).
72' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' 3 - 0 James Maddison takes the corner and Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) manages to jump the highest in the box and plants a precise header in off the crossbar. The score is 3:0.
71' James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
70' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
69' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) offside.
68' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by James Maddison (Tottenham), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
67' Tottenham are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
67' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) replaces Dejan Kulusevski.
66' Substitution. Wilson Odobert did his best and is replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
66' James Maddison (Tottenham) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
64' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
61' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
58' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the left post. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
57' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Abdoulaye Doucoure is replaced by Iliman Ndiaye (Everton).
57' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jack Harrison will be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton).
57' Jack Harrison (Everton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Anthony Taylor who sees an offensive foul.
56' Tottenham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
51' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.

49' James Maddison (Tottenham) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball after the free kick and takes good first touch to unleash a low shot from close range, but Jordan Pickford makes a nice save.
48' A clumsy foul by Michael Keane (Everton) and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Tottenham have a free kick.
47' James Maddison (Tottenham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Dejan Kulusevski does a good job setting up Pedro Porro (Tottenham) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
45+3' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes the corner with a short pass.
45+3' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) works the corner short.
45+2' The resulting free kick from Dwight McNeil (Everton) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
45+1' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45+1' Dwight McNeil (Everton) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' A dangerous looking corner kick from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cleared to safety by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
45' Dwight McNeil (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
44' The resulting corner from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
44' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
40' The game is interrupted now, Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' Pedro Porro slings over a decent looking cross towards Wilson Odobert (Tottenham), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.
38' The resulting corner from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
35' Dwight McNeil (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
34' The ball is cleared after Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
33' Total attempts – 6:1. 5:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
29' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
28' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
27' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Jordan Pickford and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
24' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
23' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
21' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
17' Jack Harrison (Everton) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
16' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

14' 1 - 0 Dejan Kulusevski looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Yves Bissouma (Tottenham), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the crossbar. The score is 1:0.
13' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' James Maddison (Tottenham) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
7' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

6' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jordan Pickford makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top left corner. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes a short corner kick.
5' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Tottenham have a corner.

3' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Jordan Pickford is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
2' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Tottenham will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will officiate today.
